name: dh-clinical-v3
look: Natural colour, documentary. Real skin tones, real daylight, real materials — warm wood, worn fabric, morning light through glass. Lived-in and human, never styled or graded. Composition top-weighted: subject in the upper two thirds; the lower third falls into soft shadow and plain surface with no detail. 35mm grain, gentle halation. Nothing tack-sharp.

jobs.scene: Close over a clinician's shoulder: a gloved hand selecting one small glass vial from a tray of several identical ones on a bright consult-room bench. Warm daylight, plants and a window soft behind. The reach and the choosing are the subject.

A clinician's hands on a bright bench, one holding a single small glass vial, the other resting on an open patient chart. Warm side light, out-of-focus consult room behind. Calm, deliberate, mid-decision.
A clinician in a soft blue shirt turning a small glass vial to read the label, elbows on a warm wooden desk, patient's file open in front. Afternoon light from a side window, real skin tones.
